headline: Kairoi Residential, PGIM, and Helaba Bank Have Broken Ground on their Ultra-Luxury Mid-Rise Development in Denver's Lower Highlands (LoHi) neighborhood.
summary: San Antonio-based Kairoi Residential, in partnership with PGIM and Helaba Bank, has broken ground on an ultra-luxury Class A multifamily development in Denver's vibrant Lower Highlands ("LoHi") neighborhood.
